result_text:
I fixed it: a dog that nothing depends on (and isn't boot-first) is now always the last stage, even when the graph has a cycle. `cargo check -p shep-core` passes. I didn't run any tests.

What changed in `crates/shep-core/src/config/graph.rs`:
1. **The fix:** the stage holding those dogs used to be added right after the ordinary order, which put it ahead of the cyclic stage. It is now added after the stages that depend on the cycle, so it comes last.
2. **Docs:** the stage-order paragraph above `plan` now reads: boot-first dogs, the ordinary order, the cyclic stage, the nodes that depend on the cycle, then the trailing dogs, "last whether or not there is a cycle".

Nothing else in the plan changed. A dog with no dependents that itself depends on the cycle still sits in the stages after the cycle, as before, not in the final stage.

Next: if an existing test encodes the old order for cyclic graphs it will now fail, so run `cargo test -p shep-core --lib config::graph` to check.
